decisions.decision: Legal expense funds for FY18 discussion tabled until the next meeting, when all FY18 encumbrances will be discussed.
decisions.quote: tabled the discussion until the next meeting when all fy18 encumbrances will be discussed.

decisions.decision: The chair will serve as liaison to work with Jack; the liaison will acknowledge receipt of any requests from Commissioners.
decisions.quote: commission discussed having a liaison to work with jack and agreed that it would be the chair.

decisions.decision: Opinions a Commissioner wants shared at a meeting will be given to Barb as a written communication to be handed out and read at the meeting.
decisions.quote: commission agreed that if anyone wants their opinion shared at meeting, it will be given to barb as a written communication to be handed out and read at the meeting.

decisions.decision: Contractor and consultant communications will be discussed by the Commission first, and the group decides who makes contact and what is communicated.
decisions.quote: the policy will be that any communications will be discussed by the commission first and decided as a group who will make the contact and what will be communicated.

decisions.decision: Requests for agenda items should be sent to the chair.
decisions.quote: commissions discussed and agreed that any requests for agenda items should be sent to the chair.

decisions.decision: Chair or a selected representative acting for the Commission needs full-board agreement by vote, including full parameters, before contacting contractors or consultants.
decisions.quote: commission agreed that the chair or a selected representative, acting on behalf of the commission, will need the agreement of

decisions.decision: All agreed to comply fully with the Open Meeting Law.
decisions.quote: all agreed to comply fully with the open meeting law.

decisions.decision: Barb will obtain any official legal opinion from counsel; one or two members may meet counsel during open office hours with questions.
decisions.quote: when commission wants a legal opinion, barb will be the one to get an official legal opinion from counsel.

decisions.decision: Day-to-day questions for Barb may be brought to a meeting rather than contacting Barb between meetings.
decisions.quote: questions about day to day tasks can be brought to a meeting instead of contacting barb between meetings.

decisions.decision: Heather L. section 2.04 of the selectmen's email policy is to be added to the communications policy.
decisions.quote: heather read the full email policy and the commission agreed to add it to the communication policy.

decisions.decision: Issues concerning the Business Manager may be discussed at a meeting, and the chair would then go to the Town Manager or DPW Director.
decisions.quote: any issues concerning the business manager could be discussed at a meeting and then the chair would go to the town manager or dpw director.

decisions.decision: Heather L. will send out the communications policy draft; Commission will review, edit, and vote on it at a future meeting.
decisions.quote: heather will send out the communications policy draft. commission will review, edit as necessary and vote on it at a future meeting.
